persons.name: Rāmabhadra
persons.evidence: kavirāmabhadrakṛtaṃ kaviprītidaṃ praśastiratnākhyaṃ kāvyaṃ samāptim agamat

date.as_written: śake dharaṇikhāgabhūparimite 1701 śucau māsi bhe samīraṇasure site haritithijyavārānvite

notes: The date verse (dharaṇi=1, kha=0, aga=7, bhū=1 = Śāke 1701, Āṣāḍha śukla ekādaśī, Thursday) marks the completion of the composition (kāvyaṃ samāptim agamat) by Kavirāmabhadra. The father's name is partially lost in lacuna (.. .. karopādhyāya).
